info.title: Magpie Admin API
info.description: The authenticated administration surface exposed only by a GUI-capable `magpie serve` when MAGPIE_ADMIN_ADDR and MAGPIE_ADMIN_TOKEN are set. It mirrors Magpie's existing desktop handler. Desktop actions are client-owned in server mode.

tags.name: Host
tags.description: Desktop-host conveniences. The calling application owns these actions in server mode.

get.summary: Get detected agents, profiles, catalog source and settings

post.summary: Set a detected agent field
Reapply Magpie's configuration or keep the agent's current value
Save agent order and collapsed sections
Save, apply or delete a profile
Refresh the catalog and ready providers' live model lists
Replace editable settings
post.description: Agent arrangement and window geometry are retained from the current settings.

post.summary: Enable or disable opening Magpie at login
post.description: Changes the autostart entry of the machine Magpie runs on.

post.summary: Share the gateway on the local network
post.description: Turning sharing on creates a LAN key the first time; `newKey` replaces it, and the previous key stops working. The gateway listener is restarted.

post.summary: Reveal the settings directory
post.description: Unsupported in server mode. Read `dir` from GET /api/settings and let the calling application handle it.

get.summary: Get installed and latest agent CLI versions

200.description: CLI versions known within a few seconds; `pending` asks the client to poll again

post.summary: Update an agent CLI the way it was installed
post.description: Runs the agent's own updater on the machine Magpie runs on.

get.summary: List the models offered to an agent

post.summary: Hide models from an agent's lists
post.description: `hidden` replaces the whole hidden set. A model the agent is currently set to is never hidden.

post.summary: Show usage as remaining instead of used
Set the window text size
post.description: Saved in settings; in server mode no window is resized.

post.summary: Replace the user's masking rules

regex.description: RE2 pattern; group 1 is masked when present

200.description: The theme, or null when Magpie does not run on Omarchy

get.summary: Get the Omarchy bar icon state

post.summary: Add or remove Magpie's icon in Omarchy's bar

409.description: Omarchy's bar is unavailable, including in server mode

post.summary: Check installed skills for upstream changes
post.description: Answers with the library view, each skill carrying what the check found.

post.summary: Upgrade RTK
post.description: Upgrades RTK on the machine Magpie runs on and returns its status by agent.

post.summary: Choose a project folder in the system picker
post.description: Unsupported in server mode. The calling application chooses the folder itself.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Days to cover; 0 or absent for all

get.summary: Get one session by its stats key

post.summary: Restart or dismiss Codex's background app-server
post.description: `restart` ends the Codex sessions on the daemon so it picks up the switched account; `dismiss` leaves it running.

post.summary: Complete a sign-in with its redirect URL
post.description: For a sign-in completed in a browser that cannot reach Magpie's local callback: submit the full URL the browser was redirected to.

post.summary: Import accounts from another tool's export
post.description: Each file's text as exported; every account is verified with its vendor before it is kept.

200.description: Per-file results and the updated provider state

post.summary: Save a StepFun browser session
Sign out of StepFun
Add, remove, update or switch off a plugin
post.description: The first plugin downloads Bun; npm installs plugins on the machine Magpie runs on. `update` updates all plugins and takes no body.

post.summary: Get the next question of a plugin sign-in method
post.description: When `key` and `value` are given the answer is validated first; an invalid one is returned as `error` with status 200.

post.summary: Sign in to a plugin provider
post.description: For an OAuth method, open the returned `url` on the user's machine and poll GET /api/signin/{id}.

200.description: A finished API-key sign-in, or an OAuth sign-in in progress

get.summary: Download the request ledger as CSV

post.summary: Save the request ledger as CSV in Downloads
post.description: Writes to the Downloads folder of the machine Magpie runs on. Remote clients should use GET /api/usage/requests.csv.

post.summary: Spend one of a Codex account's rate-limit resets

get.summary: Get a past day's gateway routes

post.summary: Lift an account's rest by hand
Perform a desktop window action
post.description: No-op in server mode. The calling application owns its windows.

204.description: Accepted; no desktop action occurs in server mode

get.summary: Get providers, presets, excluded sign-ins and gateway state

post.summary: Create, edit, inspect, test or delete a provider
post.description: The request shape depends on action. `save` accepts a Provider plus `new`, `from` and `clearBalanceToken`; the other actions principally require `id` and their relevant provider field.

200.description: Provider state, a revealed key, test results, or a refreshed model count depending on action

post.summary: Store a site's favicon as a provider icon
post.description: Finds the icon of the site at `url`, usually a provider's base URL, and stores it.

post.summary: Store a provider icon
post.description: Accepts raw image bytes, or JSON whose `data` is base64. The maximum decoded icon size is enforced by Magpie.

get.summary: List providers importable from installed applications

post.summary: Import selected providers from installed applications

get.summary: Consume a one-time import previously stashed by the desktop application
get.description: The admin API does not add a route for stashing new magpie:// links.

post.summary: Fetch and store an icon referenced by an import
Switch, forget, enable or disable a remembered account
Add, select, rename, configure, enable or remove a provider key
Start adding a subscription account
post.description: The returned status contains the URL when available. Magpie does not open a browser in server mode; poll GET /api/signin/{id} while the state is `installing` or `waiting` and let the calling application open the URL. With MAGPIE_CLI_AUTO_INSTALL=false, a missing required CLI produces an immediate error and no installer is run.

post.summary: Cancel a sign-in attempt

get.summary: Get routing groups, model choices and account/key pools

post.summary: Save, delete or restore a routing group

get.description: When `wait` is non-empty the request waits for a change for up to 25 seconds.

get.summary: Get locally recorded token and cost usage
Get subscription, plan and key allowance data

post.summary: Write an encrypted backup to the server's Downloads directory
post.description: The response contains the resulting path. No file manager is opened in server mode.

post.summary: Restore an encrypted backup
Configure or run WebDAV synchronization
post.description: `reveal` is unsupported in server mode; clients should present the server-side path themselves.

get.summary: Get shared instructions, MCP servers, skills and agent destinations

post.summary: Get descriptions for up to 60 market skill IDs
Inspect skills available at a source
Enable or disable RTK for an agent
Install RTK
post.description: Installs RTK on the machine Magpie runs on and returns its status by agent.

get.description: Session paths under the home directory are abbreviated with `~`. `terminal` is always false in server mode.

post.summary: Resume a session in Terminal
post.description: Unsupported in server mode. The session's `resume` command from GET /api/sessions remains available to the calling application.

post.summary: Reveal an allow-listed library path
post.description: Unsupported in server mode. The requested path remains available to the calling application.

403.description: Path is not in the library view

post.summary: Change instructions, MCP servers, skills, market items or synchronize all
post.description: Valid pairs are instructions/save, instructions/import, servers/save, servers/agents, servers/remove, servers/import, skills/install, skills/update, skills/agents, skills/remove, skills/import, market/server, market/skill and all/sync.

get.description: The desktop updater is not initialized by magpie serve; this endpoint is exposed for handler compatibility, not as a server update contract.

post.summary: Ask the desktop updater to check
post.description: Exposed for handler compatibility; clients should not rely on desktop update behavior in server mode.

post.summary: Ask the desktop updater to install
post.description: Exposed for handler compatibility. Quit and browser-open actions are no-ops in server mode.

204.description: Update installed; server-mode Quit remains a no-op

post.summary: Copy text through the desktop host
post.description: Unsupported in server mode. The calling application already has the text and should copy it locally.

post.summary: Open a URL through the desktop host
post.description: No-op in server mode. The calling application should open the URL locally.

204.description: Accepted; no browser is opened in server mode

HostUnavailable.description: Desktop integration is unavailable in server mode
